general.pauseUsed: This store has already used its one-time suspension

verify.hintTotp: To confirm it is you, enter the 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator...).
verify.hintPassword: To confirm it is you, enter your current login password.
verify.noSms: The system does not send OTP codes by SMS. Turn on two-factor authentication in the account menu to verify with an app instead of your password.

updateChoice.title: What would you like to update?
updateChoice.ownerOnly: Only the store owner can do this.

profile.title: Update profile information
profile.hint: Email, ID number, Representative, Date of birth, Address,...

phone.title: Update the store owner's phone number

transfer.title: Transfer store ownership
transfer.hint: Hand over store ownership to another administrator. Requires verification by the current owner.

pause.title: What is store suspension?
pause.intro: Suspending the store temporarily locks it when you don't need it, while keeping all data intact. During the suspension, no employee can use any feature of the system.
pause.term1: The suspension lasts up to 2 months. The store reopens automatically on the reopening date you choose.
pause.term2: The store owner can reopen the store before the suspension ends.
pause.term3: Data, settings and accounts are kept unchanged during the suspension.
pause.onceNote: Note: a store can be suspended only once during its lifetime.
pause.dateLabel: Automatic reopening date (up to {days} days from today)
pause.dateError: Choose a date from tomorrow up to {days} days later

transfer.title: Transfer store ownership
transfer.intro: After the transfer you will no longer be able to rename, suspend or transfer the store. The recipient must be an active administrator.
transfer.noCandidates: There are no other administrators. First create an account with the System administrator role in Settings → Users.

phone.title: Change phone number
phone.invalid: The phone number must have 10 digits, start with 0 and differ from the current one
phone.confirmPrompt: Confirm changing the store owner's phone number:
phone.usageNote: The new number is used in store information and print template headers.

profileUpdate.title: Update profile information
profileUpdate.verifyNote: To complete the update, the system needs to verify the account owner. Click "Continue" to go to the verification step.

rename.title: Rename store
rename.intro: Before renaming the store, make sure you understand the consequences.

loggedOut.title: All devices are logged out immediately
loggedOut.p1: Every employee signed in on the web and at the POS terminals will be logged out, including you.
loggedOut.p2: You are responsible for telling all employees the new store name before or right after the change.

links.title: Existing links will stop working
links.p1: Old login links and browser bookmarks containing the old name will no longer work. Update them and share the new link.

oldName.title: The old name is not kept after the change
oldName.p1: To use the old name again you must rename the store once more (all devices are logged out again).

rename.agree: I have read and understood the consequences of renaming the store
rename.newLabel: New store name (the access address entered in the first login step)
rename.rule: Lowercase letters without accents and digits only, 3–40 characters, different from the current name.

form.uploadHint: Upload the public certificate (.cer, .crt) to fill in the details automatically
form.privateKeyWarning: Use the public certificate file only. Never upload the private key (.pfx, .p12, .key).

einvoice.notConnected: Not connected — set up MISA meInvoice
einvoice.empty: No invoice packages yet. Click "Add package" to enter a purchased package.
einvoice.note: Invoice packages are entered manually according to your contract with the issuer (the system is not yet connected to MISA's quota API). "Used" is the number of invoices issued from the system, allocated by issue date to packages that are still valid.
einvoice.unallocated: {amount} invoices were issued outside the validity period / beyond the quantity of the entered packages.

terms.vietnameseOnlyNote: The Terms of Use are provided in Vietnamese only.
terms.agreeCheckbox: I have read and agree to the Terms of Use

paused.title: Store is suspended
paused.body: The store is temporarily locked and all data is kept. It will reopen automatically on {date}.
paused.ownerHint: You are the store owner and can reopen it early.
paused.staffHint: Contact the store owner if it needs to be reopened early.
